notes.title: Update on 5th of August 2025: clue annotation system
notes.notes:
In this update we added the following functionalities:

[list]
[*] A clue annotation system you can access double-clicking the board tile you want to annotate
[*] Quit button to exit the application
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for 3rd of August 2025
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Adding fullscreen functionality
[*] Ability to change contrast for the board backgrounds
[*] Adding right click to cycle numbers backwards
[*] Adding support for mouse wheel for input number cycling
[/list]
